title: Apply for Leave (Full Day): submit a valid full-day leave request end-to-end
description: Applies for a Full Day Casual Leave request via the Record Leave drawer and confirms it appears under both the All and Pending tabs on /leaves.

title: Apply for Leave (Half Day): submit a valid half-day leave request
description: Toggles the mutually-exclusive Half Day option, confirms the End Date field disappears in favor of a single Date field, submits, and confirms the request appears on /leaves.

title: Apply for Leave: validation and boundary errors are handled
description: Covers empty required fields, an End Date before Start Date, a past Start Date, requesting more days than the remaining balance, and a blank Reason, confirming each is rejected cleanly.

title: Cross-module: apply for a leave on /leaves, then cancel it via /cancellation, and verify status updates
description: Applies for a leave on /leaves, cancels it via /cancellation with a reason, and confirms the status moves from Pending to Cancelled back on /leaves.
